title: Categorical neutrality of saturated shells: full-twist identity action on $\Phi_n$ at magic $n$
html:
Statement

Proposition (Conjecture — categorical neutrality of saturated shells). Let \mathbf{C} be a rigid braided monoidal category satisfying the QOU substrate axioms (Frobenius–Hopf substrate) and let \Phi_n be the categorical mass endomorphism at level n (mass-endomorphism conjecture). Then for every n \in \mathfrak{M} the full-twist \Delta_n^2 acts as the identity on \Phi_n:

  \Delta_n^2 \cdot \Phi_n \;=\; \Phi_n \cdot \Delta_n^2 \;=\; \Phi_n
  \qquad\text{for all } n \in \mathfrak{M}.

Equivalently, \Phi_n \in \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A^{\otimes n})^{\Delta_n^2} — the categorical mass at a saturated shell is a fixed point of the full-twist action.
